name: analytics
description: Analytics workload over the pqgen datasets (stand-in for benchmarks/workloads/analytics.json, which is not present in this workspace). Tables are loaded from <scale>/<file> as in-memory column tables with the generator's schema files; every query runs with default options.

queries.name: filter + aggregate
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*), SUM(amount), AVG(fee) FROM transactions WHERE status = 'approved' AND amount > 100

queries.name: group by, low cardinality
queries.sql: SELECT category, COUNT(*), SUM(amount), MIN(ts), MAX(amount) FROM transactions GROUP BY category ORDER BY category

queries.name: group by, high cardinality + top-N
queries.sql: SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(amount) AS total FROM transactions GROUP BY customer_id ORDER BY total DESC, customer_id LIMIT 20

queries.name: join + group by
queries.sql: SELECT c.segment, COUNT(*), SUM(t.amount) FROM transactions t JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = t.customer_id GROUP BY c.segment ORDER BY c.segment

queries.name: 3-way join
queries.sql: SELECT p.category, SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = i.product_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY revenue DESC

queries.name: top-N
queries.sql: SELECT tx_id, amount FROM transactions WHERE status = 'approved' ORDER BY amount DESC, tx_id LIMIT 10

queries.name: monthly revenue (DATE_TRUNC)
queries.sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', ts) AS month, COUNT(*), SUM(amount) FROM transactions GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', ts) ORDER BY month

queries.name: orders by year and status
queries.sql: SELECT YEAR(order_date) AS y, status, COUNT(*), SUM(item_count) FROM orders GROUP BY YEAR(order_date), status ORDER BY y, status

queries.name: COUNT(DISTINCT)
queries.sql: SELECT category, COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id), COUNT(DISTINCT merchant_id) FROM transactions GROUP BY category ORDER BY category

queries.name: HAVING + top-N
queries.sql: SELECT merchant_id, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(amount) AS total FROM transactions GROUP BY merchant_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 200 ORDER BY n DESC, merchant_id LIMIT 10

queries.name: conditional aggregates (CASE)
queries.sql: SELECT currency, COUNT(*), SUM(CASE WHEN is_fraud THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS fraud_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'declined' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS declined FROM transactions GROUP BY currency ORDER BY currency

queries.name: sensor hourly profile
queries.sql: SELECT HOUR(ts) AS h, AVG(temperature), MIN(pressure), MAX(humidity) FROM sensor_readings WHERE status = 'ok' GROUP BY HOUR(ts) ORDER BY h

queries.name: per-sensor averages
queries.sql: SELECT sensor_id, AVG(temperature), MAX(humidity), COUNT(*) FROM sensor_readings GROUP BY sensor_id ORDER BY sensor_id

queries.name: IN subquery
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*), SUM(amount) FROM transactions WHERE customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM customers WHERE segment = 'enterprise' AND country = 'US')

queries.name: CTE + join
queries.sql: WITH spend AS (SELECT customer_id, SUM(amount) AS s FROM transactions GROUP BY customer_id) SELECT c.country, COUNT(*), AVG(sp.s) FROM spend sp JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = sp.customer_id GROUP BY c.country ORDER BY c.country

queries.name: scalar subquery
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM transactions WHERE amount > (SELECT AVG(amount) FROM transactions)

queries.name: DISTINCT
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT merchant_id, category FROM transactions) d

queries.name: string filter
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE email LIKE '%1@example.com' AND country IN ('US', 'GB')

queries.name: NULL-heavy aggregation
queries.sql: SELECT n50 % 10, COUNT(*), SUM(n90), COUNT(f95) FROM nulls_heavy GROUP BY n50 % 10 ORDER BY 1

queries.name: LEFT JOIN
queries.sql: SELECT o.status, COUNT(i.order_id), SUM(i.quantity) FROM orders o LEFT JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY o.status ORDER BY o.status

queries.name: 4-way join, selective filters
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*), SUM(i.quantity) FROM order_items i JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = i.product_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE c.country = 'FI' AND p.category = 'books'

queries.name: top brands (join + top-N)
queries.sql: SELECT p.brand, SUM(i.quantity) AS q, SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price - COALESCE(i.discount, 0)) AS net FROM order_items i JOIN products p ON p.product_id = i.product_id GROUP BY p.brand ORDER BY q DESC, p.brand LIMIT 10

queries.name: time range filter
queries.sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*), SUM(amount) FROM transactions WHERE ts >= CAST('2024-03-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP) AND ts < CAST('2024-04-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP) GROUP BY status ORDER BY status

queries.name: string sort top-N
queries.sql: SELECT id, str_key FROM sort_keys ORDER BY str_key, id LIMIT 100

queries.name: full reductions
queries.sql: SELECT SUM(tx_id), MIN(bucket), MAX(merchant_id), COUNT(*), MIN(ts), MAX(ts) FROM transactions
